findings.issue: REQ-014 squash `-D` reap-path prerequisite list (line 399) is an INCOMPLETE restatement of the ACTIVE predicate set: it omits predicate 2 (unpushedCommits/upstreamMissing) and predicate 4 (recentActivity), while being presented as the self-contained guard for the only automated `git branch -D`. The canonical REQ-003 step-3 `if still reapable` gate (line 157/160) DOES enforce all six predicates, so no runtime hole exists when `-D` is routed through REQ-003 — but the spec defines the same guard twice with two different predicate sets and never states REQ-014's list must be conjoined with the REQ-003 reapable classification. An implementer coding the `-D` precondition from REQ-014 alone could force-delete a PR-merged worktree that still holds unpushed local commits or was active within grace.
findings.fix: State in REQ-014 that the line-399 prerequisites are IN ADDITION TO the worktree being classified reapable per REQ-003 (all six predicates INACTIVE), OR add unpushedCommits=false and recentActivity=false to the line-399 list so the `-D` guard is self-contained. Add a PROP asserting `git branch -D` is not invoked when unpushedCommits=true despite prMergedState='merged'.
